title: LLM-assisted playbook assertion and automated scope limiter
author: Elena Morales
description: Context: On-call teams asked for more reliable automated playbook hints without increasing blast radius. This PR introduces an LLM-assisted 'assertion' generator that synthesizes concise assertions from incident context (alerts, recent traces, top logs) and an automated scope limiter that prevents auto-remediations from operating outside a safe envelope. Motivation: improve TTI for responders with high-precision suggestions while lowering the risk of runaway automated mitigations. Summary of changes: 1) new llm_assert module that takes telemetry bundle + prompt template and outputs structured assertions with confidence and provenance links; 2) scope_limiter middleware that enforces policy rules (service whitelist, max affected hosts, time-window gating, require manual approval above threshold); 3) UI card in the oncall console showing assertions and quick-apply safe actions; 4) end-to-end tests and canary rollout config. Checklist: - [x] Design doc (ENG-4871) reviewed - [x] Security review of policy enforcement completed - [x] End-to-end tests added - [x] Canary rollout configured (5% -> 50% -> global) - [x] Feature gated behind runtime flag: llm_playbook_assertion=true Rollout plan: enable only in non-prod for 48 hours, run telem smoke tests, then 5% of prod, monitor false-positive rate (target <2%), increase if safe.

release_notes: Introduce LLM-assisted playbook assertions to surface concise, provenance-backed suggestions to on-call responders. Automated scope limiter prevents unsafe automated remediations beyond configured envelopes. Feature gated and rolled out via canary. Operators should review docs/runbooks/llm_assertion.md for flags and policy examples.

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: LLM hallucination leading to misleading assertions. Mitigation: assertions include confidence and provenance links; automation paths require passing scope_limiter; manual approval required above critical thresholds. Feature is behind runtime flag and initial canary at 5%.
notes_for_ops: To enable: set runtime flag llm_playbook_assertion=true and configure scope policies in /etc/incident-bot/scope_policies.yaml. Monitor metric incidentbot.assertion.fp_rate and incidentbot.scope_limiter.blocked.
